basis: source call graph, not live profiling or measured timings

hotspots.cost: budget_check takes mutex; check calls policy then state, rehashes own bindings; boundary also inventories own scopes.
Policy validation runs twice in each check. Each policy does1 policy read+1 source reference+8 bound reads: >=20 file_bytes calls before the rest. _bindings adds another source reference.
No overlay state cache: reads legacy, parses all base paths, reads every overlay event/authority, replays all completions/prefix charges and source-bound path schemas each check.
Every scope_spec consumer binding calls bound→file_bytes→canonical Path.resolve, lstat, open/read, fstat, SHA. Shared sources are reread across each reservation, then again for own bindings.
Base has a cache; warm checks still fingerprint every discovered dependency through canonical+fresh lstat. Do not claim base always fully replays; cache invalidates when watched identities change.
Fingerprint lstat loops and canonical path resolution persist even when base replay is cached.
Every H040 guard invokes original lease/RSS/CUDA checks and full v3 budget check.
All96 pre-forward guards invoke context; exact line refs also captured by AST index in qualification receipt. Each following RAM seal writes JSON and triggers strict budget boundary.
RAMMatrix.seal delegates durable JSON to output.save; context-only throttling would leave96 strict boundary replays.
PilotOutput.save always checks strict boundary with planned len(data)+8192 immediately before write. Keep it unthrottled.
Supervisor checks full budget every15 s inside same event loop as5 s work sampling and log draining. Long mutex hold also delays those supervision duties.
H042 per-step context retains lightweight original resource checks and avoids adding full accounting on every step; writes remain guarded.

lower_bound_v3_file_reads: 21 + sum(base reservation binding counts) + sum(new-reserve binding counts) + sum(closed-measurement binding counts) + own_binding_count + 2*overlay_event_count + 5*overlay_close_count, before base fingerprint/replay and other repeated proof reads.
model_prediction_minimum: 96 pre-forward full checks +96 seal strict-boundary full checks = at least192 accounting transactions from these two sites alone.
savings: Within one operation, repeated raw reads collapse fromR logical file_bytes calls toU unique cacheable canonical paths plus uncached final namespace/identity checks; journal parsing/replay/overlap work and dependency lstat remain. No production speedup asserted.

scheduler_mutex.behavior: One exclusive original flock covers all nested budget replay and source reads.
